maria: Quick copy sprint for the Hosted / Dedicated / Private pages — need hero lines, two launch-post blurbs, and the webinar landing. Drafts by Mon?

jake: Roger. Who's the audience for each so tone matches?

sunita: Hosted = devs/PLG builders. Dedicated = platform / SRE. Private = security & compliance.

lia: I'll mock three hero directions and two CTA variants: lightweight CTA + intent CTA (Get started / Book a demo).

jake: Quick hero sketches: Hosted: `Production LLM API — minutes to first token.` Dedicated: `Reserved GPU pools for predictable throughput.` Private: `Run inference inside your VPC with audit logs and controls.`

oliver: Launch posts: 1) benchmark highlight (numbers + download), 2) customer operational story (prototype -> production). Webinar = technical deep dive + live Q&A. Gate the benchmark PDF, drive signups.

maria: Inbound routing: hosted -> self-serve onboarding, dedicated -> SDR, private -> AE + security intake. Add hidden form field `mode_interest` and UTMs to route leads.

jake: I'll include snippets like `<input type=\"hidden\" name=\"mode_interest\" value=\"dedicated\">` and A/B email subject lines.

sunita: I'll own the benchmark appendix (methodology, hardware matrix, quant/batching config). Need infra to confirm kernel/quant settings.

lia: Timeline: copy by Mon, design comps Tue, tracking + forms Wed, publish Thu, webinar Tue following week.

maria: Owners: Jake (copy), Sunita (benchmarks), Lia (design), Oliver (webinar funnel). Thanks all.
